content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a mismatch in data types between the model data returned by the device (an array of u32s) and the reference model data used for comparison (an array of u16s). This discrepancy led to incorrect comparisons during model verification, ultimately breaking the Power-On Reset (POR) initialization sequence. The patch corrected this by ensuring that the model data is read and stored as u16s, aligning the data types for proper comparison.
